Subject: Supplier portal — onboarding stuck at 'verifying' (POs on hold)

Hi Ben,

We're seeing our supplier profile for Vendor ID V-9923 stuck in the supplier portal during the final verification step. Our buyers report that new POs for V-9923 show as "Pending — verification" in Coupa and are not visible to the vendor. That means invoices can't be created and a live PO worth ~$12k is blocked.

Steps we've tried so far:
- Resent the invite from our Coupa admin console
- Cleared browser cache and tried incognito
- Confirmed email address (vendor says they received the invite)

Attached a screenshot of the vendor view and a short PO hold export. Can you advise next steps? This is blocking payment timelines.

Thanks,
Alex Dunn
Sr. Procurement Ops | AcmeTrade

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Sorry for the disruption.

Quick troubleshooting notes:
- If vendor UI shows "verifying" that often indicates an SAML attribute mapping mismatch or a claim not being persisted to the vendor profile during the final handshake.
- Can you share the vendor email address and the invite token (if you have it)? If not, screenshots + the PO export are fine; I'll request a SSO trace from our side.

I'm looping in our SSO/Onboarding team to pull the assertion logs and confirm whether the redirect returned a 200 to Coupa with the correct attributes. For a short-term workaround, we can create a manual activation on our side to unhold the PO while we fix the SAML mapping.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) Share vendor primary email (reply if you'd rather not post it here).
2) Approve manual activation to release the PO (we'll log it as a one-time exception).
3) We'll follow up with a permanent SAML mapping fix and a post-mortem.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Success (Onboarding) | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the ping — pulled the trace. Summary:
- We see a successful SAML assertion to Coupa, but the attribute "vendor_org_id" is missing in the assertion payload for this specific token. Coupa's finalization step requires that attribute to bind the transient invite to the vendor profile. Without it, the UI shows "verifying" while the backend leaves the record unlinked.
- There was a transient redirect with a 302 through the customer's SSO gateway; the assertion arrived ~3s later than usual which appears to have dropped the optional claim in our assertion builder.

Immediate remediation plan (short):
1) Karthik to run manual activation for Vendor V-9923 to set the vendor_org_id and release the PO. (We will annotate all changes for audit.)
2) Karthik to patch the assertion builder to tolerate the delayed redirect and ensure vendor_org_id is always present (deploy to staging, smoke test with a test tenant).
3) Ben to request AcmeTrade sign the one-off activation waiver so finance can proceed.

I'll attach the raw trace for your audit logging. Attaching redwood-sso-trace.log.

Marissa Cole
SSO Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
